{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the first few rows and data types
print("Data types:")
print(sales.dtypes)

print("\nFirst few values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head(10))

# Check for the presence of thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10 unique values

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"\nNumber of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Check for any invalid values (like 999999.99) that might be test orders
print(f"\nCount of revenue = 999999.99: {(sales['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum()}")"}
